about_short_description.short_description: Moneco is a financial application that aims to provide financial products.

product.name: Moneco International Bank Account
product.description: A multi-currency bank account offering IBANs in Europe (Ireland), the USA, and USDC for the African diaspora to manage finances internationally.

product.name: Moneco International VISA Debit Card
product.description: A VISA debit card linked to the Moneco account, usable worldwide for online and in-store payments, supporting Apple Pay and Google Pay.

identifier.value: Money Transfer Services to Europe and Africa

product.name: Money Transfer Services to Europe and Africa
product.description: Enables instant and standard money transfers within Europe (SEPA), to the USA (ACH), and to 11 African countries via bank transfer, mobile money, or cash.

product.name: Destination France Guide and Services
product.description: A digital guide and support service that assists African diaspora in navigating administrative and settlement procedures for studying, working, and living in France.

product.name: Fraud Prevention and Account Security
product.description: Security measures including biometric identity verification, multi-factor authentication, encryption, and real-time fraud monitoring to protect user accounts and transactions.
